dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual symmetrical reduction in lateral width from the mid-body toward the posterior terminus.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Minor localized outward protrusion on the right lateral margin relative to the smoother left margin.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Medium grey tone consistent with sub-adult pigmentation phase.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: High-frequency diffuse mottling distributed across the entire visible dorsal surface.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse, low-gradient transitions between localized darker grey patches and the lighter baseline skin.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.dorsal_surface_indentations: Pronounced longitudinal dorsal ridge visible along the central axis.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Faint, light-colored linear markings or streaks on the posterior-left dorsal flank.
